Job Requirements:

- Strong Ruby on Rails experience, including server-rendered views with ERB in a production codebase.

- Ability to work independently on features end-to-end with the team's support, from technical spike and scoping through to deployment.

- Solid testing and code quality practices, with the ability to uphold engineering standards and contribute to documentation and system health under the guidance of the Tech Lead.

- Collaborative and inclusive - engages well across disciplines, gives and receives feedback openly, pairs willingly, and takes real interest in helping less experienced engineers grow.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ruby (Remote)
jobs.description:
Role : Software Engineer – Ruby (Remote)
Location : Remote (Work from Anywhere)



 Role Overview:
We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Ruby (LLM Evaluation & Repository Validation) to work on a Full-Time basis. The projects focus on building LLM evaluation and training datasets that address realistic software engineering problems. One approach involves creating verifiable software engineering tasks from public repository histories using a synthetic method with human‑in‑the‑loop, while expanding coverage across programming languages and difficulty levels. 

 Key Responsibilities:
• Analyze and triage GitHub issues across trending open‑source libraries to identify suitable evaluation scenarios.
• Set up and configure code repositories, including Docker containerization and environment preparation for reproducible testing.
• Evaluate unit test coverage and quality metrics to assess baseline code health and test suite robustness.
• Modify and run Ruby codebases locally to measure LLM performance in bug‑fixing and code‑completion tasks.
• Collaborate with AI researchers to design and select repositories and issues that present challenging cases for LLMs. 

 Required Skills & Qualifications:
• Minimum three years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Ruby and Ruby on Rails.
• Demonstrated expertise with Git, Docker, and basic software pipeline setup for reproducible testing.
• Ability to navigate and understand complex, real‑world codebases, and to run, modify, and test them locally.
• Experience with Ruby testing frameworks (RSpec, Minitest), gem management (Bundler), and code quality tooling.
• Prior contribution to or evaluation of open‑source projects is considered a plus. 

 More About the Opportunity:
This role provides a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the artificial intelligence industry, contributing to how large language models interact with real code. The work directly influences the development of AI‑assisted software development tools and benchmarks. 

 Equal Opportunity Employer:
We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. 

 Apply Now!

jobs.title: Senior Ruby Developer - Founding Engineer (India)
jobs.description:
Reports to: CEO
Scope: New product - ground-up build, founding engineering seat


Location: Remote, India


Type: Full-time


Experience: 10+ years
About CRMified
Founded in 2011 by Joshua Hoskins, a Salesforce MVP and Hall of Famer, CRMified delivers Salesforce design and development expertise to mid-market and enterprise clients. We specialize in systems integration with a strong referral-based business, a US-based principal team and a talented delivery team in India.


CRMified runs on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) and we're in an intentional growth phase. Alongside our consulting business, we are now building a new product - and this role is the founding engineering seat for that venture.


About This Role
CRMified's CEO is a senior Salesforce technologist with a clear vision for a new product. What he needs is a senior Ruby developer who can be a true thought partner - someone who shapes architecture and product direction with the founder, and then writes the production code to make it real.


This is not a heads-down ticket-execution role and it is not a side gig. It's a full-time, in-seat position for a builder who wants to start a product: high ownership, high ambiguity and a direct line to the founder with no layers in between. You get the upside of building something from zero, backed by the stability of an established, profitable company.


What You'll Own
Product & Technical Direction


Partner directly with the founder on product strategy, technical decisions, and architecture - you are the technical voice in the room.Translate product vision into pragmatic technical plans, challenging assumptions and proposing better paths where you see them.Building & Shipping
Design, build, and ship the core product in Ruby on a modern application stack.Own the full engineering lifecycle: architecture, development, deployment (Heroku), and iteration based on real user feedback.Set the engineering foundations - code standards, CI/CD, tooling - that future hires will build on.AI-Accelerated Development
Apply AI concepts (LLM APIs, agents, retrieval, automation) both inside the product and in your own workflow to accelerate development velocity.Advise the founder on where AI genuinely belongs in the product and where it doesn't.Salesforce Ecosystem Integration
Design integrations with the Salesforce platform where the product requires it, drawing on your understanding of its data model and APIs.What You Bring
10+ years of software development experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Ruby (Rails or comparable frameworks).A track record at well-known brands or products - you've built and shipped software that real users depend on at scale.Working knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem: its data model, APIs and how modern applications integrate with it.Heroku and modern application stack experience - comfortable owning deployment, infrastructure, and the full stack.Fluency with AI concepts - you actively use AI tooling in your workflow and can reason about where LLMs, agents, and automation belong in a product.A founder-partner mindset: you want to start a product, not maintain one; you're energized by ambiguity and ownership.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with a US-based founder.Bonus Points
Prior experience as an early or founding engineer at a startup or new product line.Experience building on or alongside Salesforce (AppExchange, Heroku Connect, platform APIs).Experience integrating LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) into production applications.Experience in a founder-led, growth-stage firm.
